readerCopy.body: More of the familiar thing is not necessarily growth. Jupiter square the South Node can make an old belief, opportunity, role, or success pattern expand until its limits become impossible to miss. You may be offered more work in the area everyone already associates with you, or feel certain that the answer must be the one that worked before. The scale can hide the repetition for a while. Ask what is actually getting larger: your options, or your commitment to a pattern you already meant to leave.
